author: c47_build_recovery
scope: Recognize the exact additional .cpp.abi_stable.o suffix for both Q19 inspection object stems during metadata capture and receipt-only wrapper selection.
Keep .cpp.o and .cpp.pic.o support, with exactly one matching receipted path required per stem across all accepted suffixes.
Keep Q19 broad object export unchanged; no archive extraction, cache-directory fallback, unbound object path or first-match selection is added.
observation_limit: Existing C31 exported filenames only; these earlier failed closure attempts are not accepted Q19 input evidence and are not reused by this patch.
preserved_binding: Metadata adds an inspection object only when it is a graph-declared output with the exact known basename and an existing exported file.
issue_receipt fingerprints every selected object; execute verifies the complete receipt before wrapper discovery and again after execution.
q19_wrapping selects only paths already present in receipt.files; zero or multiple supported variants remain errors.
Actual nm-defined mangled symbols for both AddStatRequest overloads and real caller relocations remain mandatory.
Inspection tool identities, object hashes, wrapper-symbol hashes and both-caller-relocations evidence remain unchanged.
Generated --wrap arguments, complete guarded compile/link/native records and baseline/fixed pairing are unchanged.
source_review: Pinned Q19 build/conf/project_specific/yql_udf.conf:417-419 declares YQL_ABI_STABLE and OBJ_SUF=.abi_stable.
The two external AddStatRequest declarations match the existing single-column and tuple wrapper signatures.
RequestColumnStatistics still contains the three expected AddStatRequest calls; the suffix adapter does not change production requests or wrapper behavior.
Both current filename recognizers excluded the observed stable-ABI suffix, so changing only the wrapper matcher would still leave the required objects outside the receipt.
limits: Independent review and actual Q19 prepare/capture/nm/relocation/link/native runs remain pending.
This is an exact suffix addition, not a wildcard acceptance of arbitrary ABI or optimization variants.
No actual Q19 symbol or relocation proof is claimed from filenames or source inspection.
